chunks: The merit of placing fresh greenery is very great.
Al-Shaykh, may Allah the Exalted support him, said: It has been narrated from al-Sadiq عليه السلام: "Indeed, the palm-stalk benefits both the doer of good and the evildoer."

key_terms.التَّخْضِيرِ: placing fresh greenery; the use of green branches in funerary context
key_terms.الْجَرِيدَةَ: the palm-stalk or fresh palm branch placed with the deceased
key_terms.رُوِيَ: it has been narrated or transmitted

ai.seo_question: What is the benefit of placing a palm-stalk or fresh greenery with the deceased in Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This report states the great merit of placing fresh greenery, specifically the palm-stalk, in funerary practice. It conveys that this act brings benefit to both the righteous and the sinful, indicating its significance in matters connected to the deceased.
